content: "ah gotcha, so it would depend on what the case is and what actions need to take place. That's what the 8th article refers to!" She nods to herself proud to understand
"Do you expect a single ruler to handle everyone in the first place? That's a lot of people. Gonna end up delegating, or falling apart, and oh! Here we are again."
(she's still catching on to all the rules)
"You're arguments on corruption and system refute things you've already said. You just criticized me for thinking a directorship is easily corruptible, which it is."

"Power corrupts people. A system is simply a system. Having multiple branches and heads of state that are systematically elected, processed, functioning, and then passed through allows it to work and get things done. Having a single leader work fast does not mean that having multiple leaders wouldn't function effectively at all"
"You still think a pilot is all an airship needs." Irynx deflates.
"Yes, exactly."
"I criticized you for saying dictatorships are corrupt, and that is not always the case.
"But it does mean that a single leader works faster and more effective. We live in a perilous world, time is not a luxury to us."
(Can I get this pinned please <@&859848316875571261> )
"To achieve their goals and not that of the peoples."
"You keep forgetting that the people a are why we are here. They are who we fight for, not a god or a warden, the people."
"This fear mongering does not press ample need on having a single leader. Time is a luxury, but not one we are so barren with that we must sacrifice liberties to achieve"
"Roy said Arcania is one big airship. We are its passengers, our leaders will be the crew. To lead is to serve, after all. A pilot alone works but what kind of ride are we in for?"
"A single person can only stretch so far."

"Well it seems that I have brought out all my points and to the best of my abilities debated them. I am but one fighting the now obvious group consensus. I shall give up my line of arguments. I am content at getting them heard."

"Not without success in compromises. Although we stand in opposition, I have taken your words to shape the complimentary nature of the ravens, the lamplighters and the level of wardens into this draft"
"The one I cannot budge with is in the division of powers"
The speaker nods contentedly.
Vivica sighs "I did not expect to get so heated in these debates. Perhaps that is why I prefer to observe rather than engage in public speaking so much."
"It's frustrating but honestly hey, it's progress! I'm just glad to have at least a working document to work with."

A wizened woman wearing somewhat fancy clothes speaks up. "Pardon me, I know this is rather minute, but I do feel obligated to suggest that we not end up calling this form of government 'midaskian' formally. In my experience with historical texts, systems of rule named after an individual tend to either not go well or end up being renamed anyway. I'd recommend getting ahead of the curve."
"It's hard to find a fault with it. I'm hurt that we froze the wardens out at some level but well, can't have everything."

"Well, they're welcome to participate and vote within the system. But it seems that they can't always be around. The ravens for example, it would be detrimental to have policy reliant on them if they were to dissapear again"

The sprite from before speaks up. "Look at what argument and discussion has given us: *compromise*. Do you truly think such a plan can work at the level you are proposing when it barely "works" here?" She shakes her head and flies off (I'm off to bed soon, see y'all tomorrow)
"What would you suggest then?"
"I think it has everything it needs to get off the ground and if more flaws can be made apparent then it is endowed with the ability to have the people change it"

"The best parts of a republic, democracy and socialism into a Midaskian system"
(saying it again specifically because an npc did not like it XD)
`Golden. Like the Voice.` Orphy adds.
The speaker now in the stands speaks up. "I like what you had on the draft, The Republic of the United States of Arcania has a ring to it don't you think? Or The Arcanian Republic for short."

She pauses and clears her throat. "A separation state, a republic, a federalist system, a republic/federalist hybrid..." She continues on for a bit, seemingly lost in thought. "I'm not really against it being named after the first drafter per se, but didn't you also help? And many others will before it is functional and ratified." She shrugs, before nodding to Orphy. "That's not bad either. Alludes to golden triangle and to Montesquieu and Mr midask without being just the name..."
`Well, we're just naming the system, smart guy. Not the whole shebang.`
"Yes I did help draft it, but if I'm being completely honest I'm hoping to get the name as well."

(ok imma go sleep, this nerd philosopher lady is gonna be thinking for a while but can also answer questions about Montesquieu if y'all need an in character reason to know what she's referencing there)
`Well, you should get some credit in there, Miss! I know your names at the bottom but Catlan is a lot easier to say.`
"I do like that name for our new nation. But as for the new system of government we've created I do like the name given."
"I am biased though so sue me." She shrugs
"Apparently, there's some dissenting voices in the stands for the name of the system," Irynx says.
"I think the name is very fitting both for Vivica here and for the system"
"Most of my work was on the justice system and some work on the bill of rights.  I'm not searching for a legacy but I appreciate the  recognition."
`Midask-Catlan Government. That's what I'm teaching in the history classes now. That's it!`
Vivica can't help but smile at the name

"Well. If they want to smack together a bunch of fundamentally opposed systems and draft their own, they can have their name on it too haha."

He says it jokingly but gets a bit more softer and serious

"Honestly, I'd like to have one legacy that is built on helping, providing, and establishing a place where people feel heard and represented. That would be better than any statue, coin, or ball bearing dedicated to me"
"Smart. Especially if you find yourself in a deal where an evil demigod promises not to threaten anyone who knows your name. This is like, a really solid way to make sure everyone knows."
`I hope you're keeping the name in mind for if you two get hitched, too. Just a thought.`

He tilts his head
"I'm sensing you made a weird deal. I'm hoping your true name is Irynx, right?"
"Ice rinks without the sea. That'd be the name I was born with."

"Ice rinks without the c, ice rinks without the c"
He says a few times to ward off any evil demigods
She shrugs "I'll consider it. I prefer to work more under the radar, which is ironic considering my choice in partners."
"I think I have enough influence to peddle as a priestess to keep our brand new nation safe from the likes of evil demigods."
"I'm not a superstitious type generally, but I'm not without common sense when a priestess says her name is bad juju and a ward away from a demigod"
"How do you feel about your name and Vivica's on paper though? Midask-Catlan Government. Since you both fought the hardest for it. That's definitely going around."
"Back home and east from there people would probably start shortening it to something like Mi-Ca. An amicable system if you excuse the pun."

"Oh if that's the case, I'm all for Midask-Catlan." The speaker says with a smile. "A debate is a good way to get to know someone, and you and the dear captain are good people. I have no qualms with giving a bit of history to honor you both."
`You two fought for this like Niflhel.`
"I honestly was not expecting this..." Vivica is at a loss for words at the response for a name change

"It does have a ring to it but I'm not sure. Perhaps it'd just be better if we just shared my last name."
He says cheekily
"I think it has a nice ring to it," she says about no part of the conversation in particular.

"I find it interesting that when someone as the speaker or I claim that power does not inherently corrupt.... That its easier to identify a single person acting corrupt..... over an individual in a crowd.... there are only 3 or 4 voices that make bold claims of 'no that's not true'... I have power.... you have seen... some... of what I can do.  I have lifetimes of experience... But today I stand for something much more clear.... I have laid out issues with splitting.... fracturing... a government.... I have laid out issues with the foundations you are building on.... And many here know.... I stand for an ideal world.  One where life overall is precious.... and that you have to protect the many... even if it costs the few.  One that strives to respect nature.... and its impact on us all.  One in which people choose mercy.... over fear and anger.  One in which no man is forced to subservience to another.... One to find happiness before life ends."  he looks around "Are you saying that my power.... that which I have earned through action and experience.... that which I loan to others to free them from slavery they got themselves into.... That which I loan to bring back people cut short..... is the claim that I am corrupt?  Because the argument of power corrupts is flawed.  It assumes that every person is inherently evil.  That every person seeks to lord over others.  And with that assumption, it doesn't matter if its one person or 100.... they will be corrupt.  They will band togeather to get more power.... they will lie to get elected.... and lie again to get their friends elected when they no longer can.... they will make deals with devils to get what they want.... and use wishes to change what they can in their favor.... That thinking is the path of fear... Most people are generally good.  Most people don't want power.... Its far easier to find one good person.... than it is to find 100."

he thinks for a minute "Just because power would corrupt those here that are railroading this body.... doesn't mean you cant find someone that would do right by the people.  This is what I meant by dancing around the point earlier..... there is no confidence in the people.  Earlier we heard hundreds of voices mentioning people they knew were unfit to rule..... you know what we hear very little of... who is fit to rule.  I mentioned my pick.... someone that I think cares for the people.... cares for the future.... who built this city.... with all of their power.... I don't agree with his methods.... I am a bit old fashioned.... so who would you all pick as the hundred.... two hundred.... over the course of a lifetime, thousands... tens of thousands.... of people that wont and can't corrupt a system built to be changed..... That wont make back ally deals.... that wont manipulate the truth... to get themselves the power you fear.... today you might find those people.... but 200 years of changes.... that's far more likely to put those that want power on top.  That is your logic.... your untrusting logic.  If you truly believe that power corrupts.... then you believe there is no future.  If you all cant find one person you think will stand the test of time and power.... how will you find 100?"
The speaker intently watches and listens to the Mender. He agrees with all that he has said, but doesn't speak up any longer. He has debated his points already. Time to let another take the mantle.
Finn listens while updating wording on the draft but doesn't have any more to say on the subject

He pauses a moment "Also as someone from this part of the world..... don't forget.  These lands were claimed in the name of England.... In the name of the King.  These colonies are built on the lands of my people..... Is your set of laws going to outline expansion beyond these colonies?  What if the native nations do not wish you to expand to their lands?  What if the people that had these lands first want them back?  Are you all okay to just try to keep what you have?  Or is your new country going to use sword and spell to take more if they want?  These are important factors that need to be addressed in any set of laws... If people want to leave your country because they think its corrupt.... will you start a war to stop them?  If they Declare Independence from you... what is the official stance of this government?  Or is that more laws that can change at the whim of the people.... providing no assurance of stability?"

"At least with one person to talk to... You can have an idea of who you are dealing with..... but with so many voices.... there is no way of knowing who will be deciding tomorrow on the deals made today"

"Many of those items you speak of are addressed in the constitution here or would be determined by the acting body of government. A draft based in respect of the land and its inhabitants and recognizing the sovereign powers of this land. The idea is that we have set forth the precedence to act peacefully and with purpose and delegation. As for violent insurrections and domestic invasions, Congress has the power to call upon the army and militia to defend ourselves from it. States fall under jurisdiction of the federal government and are subject to legislation passed over them. If they were to attempt to rebel, the discourse would be within the senate. Generally there are many compromises and options to come before such an extreme measure is taken, but ratifying this proposal much like the formation of the continental congress would require the willing entrance of the representatives of each state."

"I see.... so no assurance at all..... just 'hopefully the legislative body will be fair and good' even when lets say Virginia is claiming that the corruption of this new government is not for them.... and they wish to leave, just as all the colonies wished to leave the corruption they claimed of England.  I would say that's no real assurance.  Likewise the native nations have no real assurance that if they say unequivocally they wish not to join you, and talks of you acquiring their lands fails.... that your Congress wont call upon its power to get what they want.  You are claiming they need to depend on dozens.... possibly hundreds.... of people to not be corrupted by the power they wield.... when the land here gets choked out... and the need for expansion becomes paramount.... Every country decides that their lives depend on expansion.... which always costs someone else.  It would be far better to make something that can't be changed.... something concrete... to assure that blood and war wont be your solution when others feel this government is the oppressor that you all claim England to be.  As you will continue railroading your vision without considering anything else.... I have nothing further that can be added here beyond a warning.... your fears and miss-trust will lead to a very bloody future... no amount of thoughts and prayers... hopes and dreams will change what you are writing today.  I will be back later to see the final result.... but there are things I should do since nothing said here matters beyond agreement with what you have drafted." The mender stands and leaves the room
Finn nods along in acknowledgement at the grandstanding but isn't much more phased by his words and will leave the Mender to his business.
"one thing we should think about. havinga test of anyone who would look at being part of leadership. we've established that we aren't all strong. it's to prove they are capable in a world of magic."
"magic can alter minds that at least needs to be considered for any leadership"
"An organized debate perhaps? Tell of one's qualities and why they should be elected or what they would do with the power?"
"more than a debate, a trial of will before being an elective candidate."
"to show how unwavering they can be"
"Having a diversity of strengths in a Triumvirate would be most beneficial rather than just a test of willpower"
"if leadership is what they are for it's more important they are keen against magic tricks

"I'm not sure physical tests like this would give us more than just a basic analysis of their attributes. If someone had a clear and laid out plan that people rally behind and believe in, but they just fail to counter charm effects on their own, it shouldn't invalidate them. However, I think your suggested tests would make a great process for the guards and whatnot to be capable of dispelling or countering such effects that may occur."
"Staff that's job would be to keep the triumvirate from being put in those situations"
"sounds like there's so many balances that it comes right back to nothing being decided by how many procedures get in place"
"you suggest a comittee that has more committees to get to the point."
"In any form of government, many people are needed. Multiple departments. One person cannot possibly cover everything on their own can they?"
"but you argue that this has it filed down when the chains a lot longer than you seem to think it is."
